overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board properly discussed the Water Pollution Control Facility reorganization plan in executive session under Purpose 3 (collective bargaining) because it was indivisible from bargaining considerations.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed a Water Pollution Control Facility reorganization plan in executive session without a proper statutory purpose.
allegations.key_passage: On these facts, we conclude that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by discussing the Reorganization Plan during executive sessions convened pursuant to Purpose 3.
